integrity: Analytic proofs and independently implemented finite numerical corroboration are included; finite checks are not substitutes for infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive amplitudes and fixed dimension; positive-real Abel boundary limits only. The published qualitative Hilbert--Schmidt threshold is credited as prior work, and historical priority of specialized asymptotic constants is not independently certified.
title: A five-regime Abel boundary law for Bessel-weighted Dirichlet series
